fixer.title: Load multi-diff text models and compute diffs on demand

introducer.title: Implements #199291 - Multi Diff Editor: Identify Input With Source, Reload File List Dynamically

cases.mechanism: Opening a multi-diff with N files eagerly acquired up to 2N text-model references and started N diff computations before the model could be published, placing filesystem/content-provider/Git reads and diff CPU for the entire change set on the editor-open critical path.
cases.symptom: Large SCM/history change sets could leave the multi-diff editor loading while all file contents were resolved and all diffs were started; the cost and external reads scaled linearly with total files rather than the visible initial batch.
cases.fixedBehavior: The editor now publishes all lightweight file entries immediately, resolves text models only through each entry's on-demand resolve callback, and starts only the first five diffs initially; visible/navigation-targeted items reuse a per-item ObservableLazyPromise, so each requested file resolves once.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, line 218 constructs an async mapped entry for every resource; that mapper calls createModelReference for both sides, and _createModel awaits Promise.all of the entire mapped collection before publishing documents. MultiDiffEditorViewModel then creates a DiffEditorViewModel and waits for each item's initial diff. The changed code instead publishes URI-only entries whose added resolve callback is invoked lazily, while MultiDiffEditorViewModel limits startup loading to items.slice(0, 5). The added 1,000-entry test asserts exactly 10 model-reference requests and 5 diff computations at initial open, directly establishing the reduced cardinality.
